what: THE EVIDENCE RECORDS' OWN LOCATORS POINT INTO /tmp, WHICH docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md EXPLICITLY REFUSES. That doc's 'A MEASURED must say WHERE THE MEASUREMENT LIVES' section says a number whose source cannot be found is not MEASURED but INFERRED from an unstated one, and requires either a reachable locator or an explicit 'MEASURED (source not durably retrievable: <why>)'. MEASURED 2026-09-22 by reading the committed records: comms/strategy_evidence/eth_pullback_2h.json and trend_donchian.json (both written by R1's 2026-09-22 corpus re-run) carry source_run '/tmp/tmp.RsNZr5lfkw/<leg>__trades.jsonl', and fvg_range_15m.json written by this session carries '/tmp/claude-0/e25wd/fvg_range_15m__trades.jsonl'; cost_stack.source has the same shape. Those directories do not survive the session that made them, so the per-trade rows behind every pooled net_r_oos -- the numbers scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py grades a real-money roster against -- cannot be re-read or re-audited by anyone. NOT introduced by E25: it is the producer's default (build_strategy_evidence.py: wd = a.workdir or tempfile.mkdtemp(...)), so it is every record's condition, and this row is filed rather than fixed because changing where the corpus lands is a decision about what gets committed, across all ~43 routable legs and both lanes' records, not a one-leg edit.
